answer: Require each agent to post a bond that can be slashed when a randomly selected task is audited against its signed work history. A newcomer may create many hollow identities, but each must lock real capital, and copied or fabricated work risks forfeiture when checks expose inconsistencies. Splitting one stake across aliases does not multiply voting weight or rewards, so sybils must tie up more funds to gain influence. Those funds cannot wander elsewhere while bonded; even an onyx-rich attacker faces a measurable opportunity cost.
